proposed_additions.definition: A fact about the initiation or occurrence of a legal proceeding related to the dispute
examples: The High Court struck down the Tamil Nadu Acquisition of Land for Harijan Welfare Schemes Act, 1978, as being ultra vire
Proceedings under Section 151, 107 and 116 Cr.P.C. were initiated against both parties on 19.07.2016.
An enquiry was conducted by the Deputy Superintendent of Police
Police initiated proceedings under Section 151, 107, 115 Cr.P.C.

proposed_additions.definition: A fact about the number or type of livestock in a Panjrapole at a given time.
examples: The Bhiwandi Panjrapole had a total cattle strength of 501 in 1958.
The Chambur Panjrapole had a total cattle strength of 191 in 1958.
The total cattle strength of all Panjrapoles in 1958 was 1674.
The Raita Panjrapole had 181 young animals in 1958.
